[[File:Harriet_Mazoon_grave.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Harriet Mazoon's grave.]]
'''Harriet Mazoon''' was the mother of former [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] agent [[Jonni Skaak|Jonthol Mazoon]], later known as the [[Skaak Tippers|Skaak Tipper]] Jonni Skaak. She died some time before [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and was buried in [[Kaadara]]. After the [[raid on the Skaak Tipper Hideout]], the spacer who killed Jonni Skaak later brought Jonni's journal to his mother's grave.<ref name="SWG:TLaDoJS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Harriet Mazoon was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TLaDoJS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Harriet Mazoon was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
